description: Shared contract for RGB domain 0x10 version 5 (lighting rules): every registry entry's stable id, parameters and meaning, as docs/architecture/lighting-rules-v1.md defines them. The firmware's registry rows and every client descriptor implement this file; tests/fixtures/lighting_vectors_v1.json holds the vectors each entry must pass. Ids are never reused.

parameterTypes.layerSelector: a logical layer below the keyboard's layer count, or 255 for any layer
parameterTypes.modeSelector: a supported pointing-mode slot 0..31, or 255 for any mode
parameterTypes.thingSelector: an authored combo/behaviour row 0..127, or 255 for any; absent rows yield no subject
parameterTypes.comboRole: 0 combos owning the shown preview or mode, 1 the other held combos, 255 both
parameterTypes.behaviourStates: bit 0 branch selected, bit 1 tap, bit 2 hold, bit 3 long hold; bits 4..7 zero; at least one bit set
parameterTypes.behaviourScope: 0 each key, 1 newest per half, 2 newest, 3 newest per state
parameterTypes.keySet: a key-set index below the domain's key-set count
parameterTypes.paletteIndex: a palette index below the domain's palette count
parameterTypes.map: a map index below the domain's map count
parameterTypes.layerStatus: 0 top layer, 1 held, 2 locked, 3 one-shot armed
parameterTypes.behaviourPhase: 0 branch selected, 1 tap pending, 2 hold pending, 3 active hold tier, 4 active long-hold tier
parameterTypes.modifierState: 0 real/weak/locked-one-shot active modifiers, 1 armed one-shot modifiers
parameterTypes.hostLock: 0 Caps Lock, 1 Num Lock, 2 Scroll Lock
parameterTypes.pointerState: 0 auto-mouse target on, 1 auto-mouse fading, 2 sniping, 3 latest raw sensor x/y nonzero

facts.name: layer active
facts.meaning: Each active layer, highest first. Layer 0, the base layer, is always active.

facts.name: layer previewing
facts.meaning: The layer a pending momentary hold previews.

facts.name: pointing mode active
facts.meaning: The pointing mode shown. Its keys and halves are those of the key or combo that started it.

facts.name: combos held
facts.meaning: One subject for every held combo of the role, excluding combos whose output holds a momentary layer: their keys and the halves those keys are on. Thing 255, so the combo table's default identity.

facts.name: behaviour state
facts.meaning: Gestures whose shown state is in the mask; a flashing state counts only while lit; a key in a held combo's footprint never shows a selected branch. Scope 0: each key. Scope 1: the newest gesture on the left half, then the right, each with that half only. Scope 2: the newest gesture. Scope 3: for each state in the mask, long hold first, the newest gesture that entered it while its key still shows it. Identity slot from the state. Thing 255.

facts.name: combo held
facts.meaning: One subject per identified held combo, newest completion first; same roles and layer-hold suppression as fact 4. Its own id, input keys and halves; identity slot zero. Unidentified fallback outputs omitted.

facts.name: behaviour
facts.meaning: One subject per key of an authored behaviour row, matrix order. Captured row id and selected colour slot; branches suppressed under combos and flashing states only while lit. Includes layer/mode holds Standard delegates to their scenes. Intrinsic/bypassed gestures omitted. No aggregate scopes.

facts.name: layer status
facts.meaning: Real layer ownership, highest layer first; owner keys are the actual momentary bindings, including a combo output representative owner only. Top uses highest active layer; locked and one-shot use ownership state. No inferred automatic-activation provenance.

facts.name: mode status
facts.meaning: Actual held or locked pointing mode and its real owner keys/halves.

facts.name: combo layer
facts.meaning: Identified held combo outputs whose representative owner actually holds a layer; newest completion first. Its input keys and halves.

facts.name: behaviour phase
facts.meaning: Authored per-key gesture phases independent of Standard flash visibility. Matrix order, captured row id, branch and colour slot. A selected branch may also have a tap or hold pending.

facts.name: macro playing
facts.meaning: Actual named VIA macro playback slot, including cleanup. Direct unnumbered payloads yield no subject.

facts.name: key pressed
facts.meaning: Physical matrix keys down, matrix order; each subject owns its actual key and half.

facts.name: modifier
facts.meaning: Actual active real/weak/locked-one-shot modifier masks or armed one-shot mask, with left/right/either selectors. Either yields left then right.

facts.name: host lock
facts.meaning: Actual host Caps/Num/Scroll LED state from the USB half.

facts.name: pointer
facts.meaning: Actual auto-mouse target active/fading and automatic/manual sniping; latest raw sensor x/y before suppression or mode transform. Raw reports may contain noise; no continuation timer. The split peer sees the latest committed observation, and a sample can be replaced before collection/publication.

facts.name: idle
facts.meaning: Actual RGB sleep predicate: effective timeout nonzero and QMK input activity elapsed strictly greater than timeout. No extra duration or veto. Preserved global sleep forces black, even when this fact matches.

targets.name: the subject's keys
targets.meaning: The LEDs of the subject's keys; the whole board when it has none.

targets.name: the subject's halves
targets.meaning: The halves the subject concerns; the whole board when none.

targets.name: the subject layer's mapped keys
targets.meaning: LEDs of keys that are neither KC_NO nor KC_TRNS on the subject's layer, read live from the keymap; none for a subject that is not a layer.

targets.name: the subject's place
targets.meaning: The target named by the subject's thing record; none for a kind without a table.

paints.name: clear
paints.meaning: Says nothing; what is below shows.

paints.name: identity
paints.meaning: The subject's identity colour from its thing record; clear when it has none.

paints.name: map
paints.meaning: The map's value at the LED: a palette colour, or the parameterless paint 0x80 + k names.

paints.name: tint
paints.meaning: (below x (255 - amount) + colour x amount + 127) / 255 per channel.

paints.name: outcome
paints.meaning: For a fact-8 hold or long-hold, the identity of its resolved supported layer or single pointing-mode outcome. Other subjects, tap/branch slots, ordinary key/modifier/macro/unsupported outcomes, absent tables or none identity say clear; palette black stays opaque. Map value 0x88.

timings.name: show after
timings.meaning: Amount 0 until the subject has existed for the delay, then 255. Gate observation and wake times use each half's local clock, separately from synced paint time; backward samples do not advance or rewind gates and a forward 32-bit timer wrap advances normally.

domainExtensions.name: auto-mouse fade
fields: mode: 0 real destination, 1 end colour where the effect would show, 2 end colour on all keys
base: the bottom rule count forming the fade's scene, 0..R
domainExtensions.meaning: Outside the registries: while auto-mouse fades, the scene is walked with and without the auto-mouse layer and blended by the fade progress.

domainExtensions.name: tap-commit flash
domainExtensions.meaning: A committed non-base tap flashes its tap colour. Behaviour-affecting: applied at the strict activation boundary. Absent: no tap-commit flash.

thingKinds.name: behaviour
colourSlots: ... one per branch up to the tap depth

references.colour: 0x00..0x7f a palette index below P; 0xff none; 0xfe inherit (thing records only)
references.place: a place-capable target id; 0xfe inherit (thing records only)
references.mapValue: 0x00..0x7f a palette index below P; 0x80 + k the parameterless paint k (0x80 clear, 0x81 off, 0x83 identity)
